expected_outcome: Accept (v1 hand review): Green Goblin gives every nonland card in the graveyard mayhem and makes graveyard casts cost {2} less. Thrill of Possibility's discard is a cost, so the discarded card becomes castable from the graveyard at a discount the same turn: it draws two and turns the commander on, at instant speed. Mystic Remora only draws off opponents' noncreature spells and never interacts with the commander. Norman Osborn decks play Thrill 37.6% vs Remora 19.2%; overall ranks 212 vs 101 (both staple tier).
